en.headline: Election Committee turnout reaches 95.60 per cent by 3pm
en.dek: Official figures show 5,458 of 5,709 eligible electors have voted as of 3pm on Sunday, surpassing the final turnout of the previous election.
body: The Registration and Electoral Office said cumulative voter turnout in the Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections reached 95.60 per cent by 3pm on Sunday, with 5,458 ballots cast out of 5,709 eligible electors.

The figure exceeds the final turnout of 89.77 per cent recorded in the 2021 election. Polls opened at 9am and are scheduled to close at 6pm. Several subsectors have already recorded 100 per cent turnout.

Electoral Affairs Commission Chairman Justice David Lok earlier described voting as orderly and urged remaining eligible voters to cast their ballots before the deadline. Members of the new Election Committee will nominate and elect the next Chief Executive.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉截至下午3時投票率95.60%
zh.dek: 選舉事務處公布，截至周日下午3時，5709名合資格投票人中已有5458人投票，累積投票率達95.60%，已超越上屆最終投票率。
body: 選舉事務處表示，選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉截至周日下午3時，累積投票人數達5458人，投票率95.60%。
這個數字已超越2021年選舉的最終投票率89.77%。投票站由上午9時開放，至下午6時結束。多個界別分組的投票率已達100%。
選舉管理委員會主席陸啟康法官早前形容投票過程有序，並呼籲尚未投票的合資格選民在截止前投票。新一屆選委會委員將負責提名及選出下任行政長官。
